findings.text: the positive control keeps the first 20 passing candidates (positive = [...][:20]) out of up to 100 composed accepted sources, so a composed control the selector or qualifier rejected is invisible; the control proves 'at least 20 pass' but records no pass rate over the 100 candidates, and the JSON carries candidate_count=100 beside 20 rows with nothing accounting for the other 80

SELECTOR_REASONS is mapped onto the production clauses by position and only the clause count is checked (len(clauses) != len(SELECTOR_REASONS)), so a production reorder that preserves the count relabels the production clause reasons silently; the boolean flags stay correct but every human-readable refusal reason becomes wrong

qualification() re-implements the skip/override branch of _apply_unit_overrides (imas_codex/standard_names/sources/dd.py:222) by calling resolve_unit directly and then calling the owner a second time, resolving the same path twice; the skip reason should be taken from the owner rather than duplicated

assert sum(class_counts.values()) == len(cohort) cannot fail: rows is appended once per cohort member, so the counter always sums to len(cohort) whatever the classification is; it reads as coverage but guards nothing

the covered class's second arm (source recorded_name in prior_holders) is dead in this population because recorded_name_count is 0 across all 1438 rows, and the brief's 'the same quantity, through another source' sub-case is never attempted, so a removed DD path already represented by another accepted name is reported ineligible

item_verdicts.call_sites: no production call site was found; no module under imas_codex/ or tests/ references the census script, so none exists.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 6367074c; four commits add 495 lines across the three declared files, with the selector literals read from production via AST.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when needs one classified row per population member with counts by class, IDS and node category summing to the population, a passing 20-source positive control and a log ending EXIT=0; census-delivery.log ends EXIT=0 and the JSON's class_counts, by_ids (66 IDSs) and by_category each sum to 1438 with positive_control count 20.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to classify every stale DD source without a name as dropped, covered, ineligible or other through the extraction's own predicate; sib-stale-source-census.json holds 1438 rows each carrying one of the four classes with the selector's reason as evidence.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, four commits, the census command in the tests key, census-delivery.log in test_logs, and no baseline_suite or after_suite arm.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the pointer declares the json, html and -run.py under docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/; the diff lands exactly those three and nothing else.

justifications.durability: no test file exists for the change; the guards at sib-stale-source-census-run.py:63, :161 and :331 have named failure conditions but run only when the one-shot census runs, no mutation was recorded, and the reason mapping at :62 is only count-checked.
justifications.evidence: census-delivery.log ends EXIT=0 and the JSON I read directly records class_counts summing to 1438, by_ids (66 IDSs) and by_category summing to 1438, and positive_control count 20; the [:20] slice at sib-stale-source-census-run.py:322 weakens what the 20 proves.
justifications.fit: the module follows the repo idiom (future annotations, list[str] annotations, a module docstring) and introduces no plan, phase or ticket identifier in its names.
justifications.goal_fidelity: sib-stale-source-census.json holds 1438 rows each classified into the brief's four classes with the selector's own reason as evidence, answering dropped-vs-retired, but the covered class is only partially realised at sib-stale-source-census-run.py:381.
justifications.reuse: the script reads the selector from extract_dd_candidates via AST and calls qualify_dd, _apply_typed_dd_resolutions and _apply_unit_overrides rather than writing a second predicate, but qualification() at sib-stale-source-census-run.py:223 duplicates the skip/override fragment of its owner imas_codex/standard_names/sources/dd.py:222.
justifications.scope_discipline: all 495 added lines land in the three declared write paths and nothing else in the diff; the script only reads the graph (gc.query) and calls _apply_unit_overrides with write_skipped=False, so no graph write occurs.
